### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /page — 1cr

Returns data from a Linktree page including the user's display name, bio, avatar, and list of links with titles and URLs.

**Parameters**

- `url`: Full URL of the Linktree page

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/linktree/page?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## What Linktree is for

One endpoint, `/page` (1cr): the links behind a creator's bio link.

This is **offer-ladder reconnaissance**. A creator's bio link is where their funnel actually
starts — the order and labelling of those links is their offer stack, stated in their own
words. One credit buys the whole ladder: free lead magnet, low-ticket, call booking, community.

> ⚠️ `prism/lookup` (0cr) does **not** resolve link-in-bio URLs — verified 07.10.26 in this
> workspace against linktree and personal domains. Do not burn a turn on the free dispatcher
> for these; come straight to the platform-native `/page` endpoint.

Sibling platforms with the identical shape: `linkbio`, `linkme`, `komi`, `pillar`. Check the
handle's bio to see which service they use before guessing — a wrong platform is a wasted
credit, not an error.
